name: KDM6 staged ice-number diagnostic contract
default_initialization: Unchanged strict simultaneous number-cap and mean-particle-mass policy; no initialized file is published by this diagnostic.
call_parameters: qmin from the pinned model epsilon; ncmin=10 and dt=20 are declared local experiment inputs, not an observed first WRF call.

stage_conditions.WRAPPER: Volume number is the source REAL32 product of public NI and provided DEN; density is not inferred inside this contract.
stage_conditions.ENTRY: Source min(max(NI,0),1e6) is required here; its actual change must be recorded.
stage_conditions.SLOPE: The first slope consumes the limited NI without repairing it; its reciprocal slope is bounded separately. This is not a second number cap.
stage_conditions.PSD1: Active when QI >= 1e-14, including NI=0. Source lambda bounds may reconstruct NI above the entry cap.
stage_conditions.PSD2: Same active gate as PSD1, evaluated with this stage's actual QI and NI; no global number cap is imposed.
stage_conditions.PSD3: Active when QI >= qmin and NI >= ncmin after preceding cleanup; no global number cap is imposed.
stage_conditions.FINAL: Public NI is the source REAL32 division of internal number by provided DEN; an entry cap is not asserted at this stage.

allowed_native_adjustments: Exact source entry and PSD adjustments are counted as native semantics; this is not scientific approval of their magnitude or permission to publish an otherwise inadmissible initialization.
density_scope: File-state float32 1/(AL+ALB) proxy supplied to a standalone local column; actual first-advection and first-microphysics DEN are unobserved.
